scope: Shared read-only supported-input dependency validation and runtime regressions only. No renderer/composition/source plate changes, no commits or staging.

implementation.onePass: Episode parsed once; dependency portable path resolved and bytes read/hash computed once per entry; supported scene/font/audio preparation retained and returned to loader; no report/load recursion.
scene: Explicit mechanism-scene-1 version check with offending version and JSON source path
All independently resolvable label anchor and proofTarget references checked
font: Actual bounded SFNT identity parser and exact-copy cmap coverage
Authored cut identity, strict/legacy severity, qualifications/captions/graduation digits
Explicit variable-axis range validation; actual parsed font axes returned
Declared license reference remains schema-validated and license bytes/hash participate in all-dependency pass
audio: Exactly one selected audio stream, 48 kHz PCM, 1 or 2 channels, 1/48000 time base, positive exact integer duration_ts
Actual sample clock metadata reused by loader
Probe timeout 15000 ms and max output 262144 bytes
implementation.findings: Retains all independent supported-input faults alongside every missing/hash finding. Matching-hash status now separates hashValid from capability valid. Loader error context retains complete findings as diagnosticsJson. Hash mismatch bytes are not parsed as trusted capability inputs.
implementation.readOnly: No render, cache, write, mkdir or lock invocation in new dependency inspection helper. Runtime tests snapshot entire temporary project parent: relative file inventory, SHA, size and mtime before/after dry run and loader.

checks.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/mechanism-dependencies.test.ts tests/runtime/mechanism-project.test.ts tests/runtime/mechanism-failures.test.ts --maxWorkers=2 --no-file-parallelism

Supported exact 48 kHz mono PCM4800 sample positive; actual sample metadata and scene/font preparation reused; source inventory unchanged

limits: No human visual/listening acceptance implied by supported-input checks.
Missing or hash-mismatched bytes retain those identity findings; capability diagnosis is intentionally skipped until the dependency identity is repaired.
Legal font-license acceptance is unchanged; validation checks declared license relation and hash availability, not legal interpretation.
Full milestone software/baseline/native export verification remains parent-owned.
